_comment: Settlements chosen BY HAND because their environment is unusual. A random or even stratified sample of world populated places finds the common cases; it does not find a village under a rock overhang. Each row names the phenomenon it is here to cover. Coordinates are resolved through Nominatim by name + country at survey time and cached; 'near' is a rough lat/lon used only to reject a wrong name match (> 25 km away).
